name: GA Cuber Jackets Warm Up 2025

venue.name: Georgia Tech Engineering Science & Mechanics Building

information:
This competition has odd events (7x7x7, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, and Face-Turning Octahedron) and not the normal 3x3x3 Speedsolving event.

We recommend Parking at the Visitor Lot 1 [here](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Area+1+-+Visitor+Parking/@33.7713346,-84.3949982,18.96z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x88f50462c3f3cee5:0xe0dbe96335dc0d29!8m2!3d33.7709941!4d-84.3944961!16s%252Fg%252F11h1ltrgtp?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDIxMi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%253D%253D). Parking is $2/hr up to $15/day.

The Georgia location for the Southeast FMC Championship will happen in the same room 1 hour after this competition ends. If you are interested you will need to register for that competition as well as this one to participate in both.

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about)! **Please check out the Southeast Cubing tab to learn more about the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast and what you can do to support the mission.**
